shoulder_flex.source: ACE Seated Row: arms straight, reaching for the handle (illustrative 30 degrees of forward reach); drive the elbows back close to the ribs until the handle touches the stomach (illustrative -20 degrees of extension). No exact angle is given, so both ends are illustrative

elbow_flex.source: ACE Seated Row: arms straight at the reach (illustrative 5 degrees); elbows bend as they drive back until the handle touches the front of the stomach (illustrative 100 degrees). Illustrative, no exact angle given

torso_lean.source: Seated cable row form guides (Olaben, TZFIT): sit tall, only a small natural lean; stop the backward lean at roughly upright, as if a pole stood behind the back for the whole set

shrug_cm.source: Seated cable row form guides: keep the shoulders down and away from the ears through the whole pull

muscles.peakSource: ACE Seated Row: "pause for one second" at full contraction, squeezing the shoulder blades together, before slowly returning; back-muscle effort is highest through that squeeze

mistake.name: Rock and shrug

tells.text: The torso rocks back hard to help finish the pull.
The shoulders creep up toward the ears.

mistake.source: Seated cable row mistake guides (Olaben, TZFIT): rocking the torso from a far-forward reach to a far-back finish turns the row into a full-body swing and a lower-back exercise; shrugging hands the pull to the upper traps instead of the mid-back

sources: Contact fact (D-FG7 (j), row handle): V-handle at the low pulley, both hands (ACE Seated Row / Motra Cable V-Handle Seated Row)
